[d0667] changelog | PaderQueue 2.2 release notes | version 2.2
# PaderQueue 2.2 release notes

Released on 2022-12-12.

## New features

- New option `broker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `acktracker.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

- New error code PQ-E4371 (ACKTRACKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4711 (ACKTRACKER_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.

- New option `snapshotter.log_level`: log verbosity of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

- New error code PQ-E3828 (METRICS_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
